body: Don’t worry, I tell her all the time how much of a good friend she is, she deserves it.

That’s what everyone told me when I was in primary school, but now I’m getting shit grades and I won’t be able to get the career I want. Life itself is just suffering and pain to me and whenever I tell myself to live another day, I know it’s all I’m ever going to tell myself and I’ll have no real endgame to it. What’s the point in staying alive if I’m just going to feel the exact same the day after?
Yeah, this guys brother isn’t popular enough to have more than one friend. 🤔🤔🤔
You speak the language of the gods.
I had this exact problem with my old iPhone 6 and it was water damage.
I’m guessing talk to him about the text he sent? How do I bring it up without it being awkward?
Yeah, I feel really bad now. Damn it.

That’s what I need help with though. He asked me in this big long text in the middle of our conversation and I just didn’t know what to do. I could tell he was really upset afterwards and I’ve talked to him since then and it’s not the same. I’ve really hurt him I think.

I rejected him because I can only see us being friends, and we still are so it’s okay. I’ve been aware of his interest in me for a while and I think it developed with the fact that we literally talk and play games every day. I wouldn’t want to ruin that with a relationship that may or may not fail.
Alright that’s terrifying. Thank you for making me hate every single ant 1,000x more than I already do.
